name: example-profile-update
description: Update a supplied display name on an example public-profile form and verify persistence. Use only for the specified profile field.
preconditions: The user identifies the target profile and supplies the desired display name.
An authorized browser or service tool can read and edit that profile.
steps: Read the current profile and identify the display-name field within the profile form.
Change only the supplied display-name value and save when requested.
Leave unrelated notification and account settings unchanged.
verification: Reopen or independently read the profile and confirm the persisted display name.
Confirm the unrelated notification setting retains its original value.
recovery: If saving times out, inspect the persisted profile before considering another submission.
If access or resulting state cannot be established, stop the write and report the specific limitation.
